say:1:1035829001:0.text: I've been assigned to monitor this scary-looking Hypogean Rift.
say:1:1035829001:0.source_cn: 我被安排在这里盯着这可怕的恶魔裂隙。

say:2:1035829002:0.text: On the off chance that a Hypofiend emerges from it...
say:2:1035829002:0.source_cn: 万一有什么魔物从裂隙里跑了出来……

choice_prompt:3:1035829002.text: On the off chance that a Hypofiend emerges from it...
choice_prompt:3:1035829002.source_cn: 万一有什么魔物从裂隙里跑了出来……

say:4:1035829003:0.text: No, my job is to ring this bell and warn everyone, then wait for the Templars to save me.
say:4:1035829003:0.source_cn: 我就负责摇铃警告周围的人，然后等待圣骑士们过来救我。

say:5:1035829004:0.text: Ugh, they should've picked someone stronger to watch this rift...
say:5:1035829004:0.source_cn: 唉，为什么不能直接派个厉害的人来看守裂隙呢……

choice_prompt:6:1035829004.text: Ugh, they should've picked someone stronger to watch this rift...
choice_prompt:6:1035829004.source_cn: 唉，为什么不能直接派个厉害的人来看守裂隙呢……

say:7:1035829005:0.source_cn: 你说得对，能力越大，责任越大。

say:8:1035829006:0.text: But I still have a vital job to do when it comes to the rift.
say:8:1035829006:0.source_cn: 可要是裂隙出了事，我的责任也不小啊。

choice:6:0:1.text: Do they have other things to do?
choice:6:0:1.male: Do they have other things to do?
choice:6:0:1.female: Do they have other things to do?

choice:3:0:1.text: It's your job to take it out?
choice:3:0:1.male: It's your job to take it out?
choice:3:0:1.female: It's your job to take it out?

say:10:1035829007:0.text: Really? I can't thank you enough for this!
say:10:1035829007:0.source_cn: 真的吗？那真是谢天谢地。
say:10:1035829007:0.male: Really? I can't thank you enough for this!
say:10:1035829007:0.female: Really? I can't thank you enough for this!

say:11:1035829008:0.text: The truth is, I'm mostly afraid of a hand popping out and dragging me in there.
say:11:1035829008:0.source_cn: 说实话我真的害怕里面突然伸出一只手把我抓进去。

say:12:1035829009:0.text: I just wish I was as strong as you.
say:12:1035829009:0.source_cn: 要是我也能像您这么厉害就好了。
say:12:1035829009:0.male: I just wish I was as strong as you.
say:12:1035829009:0.female: I just wish I was as strong as you.

choice:3:1:2.text: I can help you get rid of it.
choice:3:1:2.male: I can help you get rid of it.
choice:3:1:2.female: I can help you get rid of it.
